measurement.scope: only the declarations under test are measured; testbench and package chain files outside the suite are ignored

pages.v_line: statement coverage, including one point per case item
pages.v_branch: branch coverage of procedural if and else arms
pages.v_toggle: one point per instrumented signal bit, hit when the bit changes at least once

measurement.denominator_rule: the observed point count of every measured file must equal the pinned value below, so a suite can never close by measuring fewer points

not_applicable.fsm_state: none of the graph common declarations contains a state machine; the demux and reduction pipelines are unconditional shift stages and the packages are declarative
not_applicable.v_branch/globals_cu_pkg.sv: GLOBALS_CU_PKG contains only parameter declarations, so Verilator emits no statement or branch point for it
not_applicable.v_toggle/packages: packages declare no signals, so the package suite has no toggle point
not_applicable.array_struct_type_demux_bus.BUS_WIDTH: the RTL hardcodes two destinations, so BUS_WIDTH is not a sweep axis and only DATA_WIDTH is swept
not_applicable.demux_bus.SEL_WIDTH default at BUS_WIDTH: $clog2(1) is zero, which is a null selector range, so the single destination instance overrides SEL_WIDTH to 1
not_applicable.sum_reduce.backpressure: the reduction has no flow control; the fixed two cycle latency is proven instead
